answer: One concrete way an agent economy resists sybil attacks is to gate every new agent identity behind a staked economic inlet that must be earned, not claimed. Agents lock collateral and build reputation through verified work, so spinning thousands of fake bots becomes costly instead of free. This turns trust into a nectar that only honest, persistent agents can harvest. Over time, the network composes each agent's record into a sonnet of on-chain behavior — hard to forge, easy to verify.
